name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Comprehensive scholarship scheme providing compulsory non-refundable fees and maintenance allowance to SC students in Classes 11, 12, and post-matriculation stages.

eligibility_criteria.notes: Income ceiling Rs. 2.50 Lakh per annum.

benefits.description: Full non-refundable institutional fee reimbursement plus annual maintenance allowance starting at Rs. 4,000/- for Class 11-12 day scholars.

application_period.notes: Verified against official guidelines. Window status: closed.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Scholarships will be paid to students whose parents/guardians' income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/- per annum.
evidence.source_title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students - MoSJE Guidelines

evidence.supporting_excerpt: The objective of the scheme is to appreciably increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio of SC students in higher education
evidence.source_title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students - MoSJE Guidelines

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Applicable to all post-matriculation or post-secondary courses including Classes XI and XII.
evidence.source_title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students - MoSJE Guidelines

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Academic allowance ranging from Rs. 4,000/- to Rs. 13,500/- per annum depending on study level
evidence.source_title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students - MoSJE Guidelines
